claims: Vanuatu is officially the Republic of Vanuatu.
Vanuatu is a South Pacific island nation in Melanesia.
Vanuatu is comprised of 83 volcanic islands.
Port Vila is the capital and largest city of Vanuatu.
Port Vila is located on Efate.
Vanuatu is located approximately 1,750 km east of northern Australia.
Vanuatu is located west of Fiji.
The population of Vanuatu is approximately 326,740 people.
Bislama is an official language of Vanuatu.
English is an official language of Vanuatu.
French is an official language of Vanuatu.
The currency of Vanuatu is the Vanuatu Vatu (VUV).
Vanuatu is primarily mountainous.
Vanuatu has a tropical rainforest climate.
Vanuatu includes several active volcanoes.
Port Vila is the main economic hub of Vanuatu.
Espiritu Santo is the largest island of Vanuatu.
Mount Yasur is an active volcano on Tanna.
98.5% of Vanuatu's population is Ni-Vanuatu.
Vanuatu was formerly known as the New Hebrides.
The New Hebrides was jointly managed by Britain and France.
Vanuatu gained independence in 1980.
The SS President Coolidge wreck is a scuba diving site in Vanuatu.
Espiritu Santo has blue holes.
Vanuatu has an underwater post office.
Champagne Beach is in Vanuatu.
International flights to Vanuatu are available from Australia, New Zealand, and Fiji.
